protocol: paired experiment (88 feasible site-fold cells) - SEPARATE optional baseline

arm_supervision.ON: C+S (same-site support supervised -> site-specific prior available)
arm_supervision.OFF: C+R (both parts from other sites -> zero target-site training subjects -> pre-declared fallback to the fold-wide optimization-training prior)

note: The two arms are not independent evidence: the number of independent subjects is 836, and the ON/OFF rows duplicate the same subjects.

constant_within_cell.correct_interpretation: a constant inside a cell gives AUC 0.5 within that cell, but a site's constants can differ across folds, so it does NOT follow that every site's AUC is 0.5. Measured: OFF site-macro AUC = 0.5000 (all 18 sites at 0.5) while ON site-macro AUC = 0.4763.

placement: supplement (per the review): the ON/OFF paired baselines belong in the supplement, with the pooled nature of the summary stated explicitly
